items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Clarence Muse, the man in pictures, he was on the show with us.

ctx.x: Playing theater. How big a band did he play?
I'll tell you who was with us. Now you believe this is a lie, in the hand of Jesus. Clarence Muse, the man in pictures, he was on the show with us.
